experiment: L3SF: N=15 L=3 shell-first two-stage SPSA (freeze Uc at start, fit shells, then freeze shells and fit Uc) vs JOINT vs QAOA p=3
l3ts_closed: PR99 joint-then-shell FAIL on 10360-67; this stream is the reverse order

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N15 L=3 Q=3072, setting SNAP shells first with shared Uc frozen at each center-4 start, then fitting only Uc, recovers a Nov3 energy edge vs matched QAOA p=3 without being worse than full-budget JOINT.
hypothesis.not: Not L3TS (that was joint-then-shells). Not pair-phase. Not per-cavity SNAP. Not a GR patch. Not more L2 center-4 copies.

split_documented_before_fits.shell_stage: 4 equal center-4 starts, shell-only SPSA, Uc frozen at each start's x0 (start 0: gamma=0.25, theta=0). T=Q_shell/8-6=186, per_start=384. Frozen gains c=0.1 A=25 clip 2σ, energy among init/last/Polyak/mid. method_id 82.
split_documented_before_fits.then: take the single best-so-far x; freeze shells = x[3:]
split_documented_before_fits.uc_stage: 2 equal SPSA blocks from that x, Uc coords only (gamma, theta_K, theta_M), remaining Q=1536, T=Q_uc/4-6=378, per_block=768. Each block recalibrates a0 under Uc sigmas. method_id 83. Energy among init/last/Polyak/mid; pick better of the 2 blocks.

arms.JOINT: frozen v4 center-4 equal-4, full Q=3072 on all params, T=378, nstarts=4
arms.SHELL_FIRST: documented split above, original Nov3 shared-Uc + per-layer SNAP shells, no pair-phase
arms.QAOA: p=L=3, fair v4 center-4, matched Q=3072, T=378, nstarts=4

seeds.collision_check: window 10360-10375 only; 10360-67 used by L3TS; not 10320-35 D18/FT pair-phase; not 10344-59 local R25; not 10376+ reserved; not holdout 10144-51; not validation 11000-11031; not final 20000-20999; not prior LE/FT/local bands

selection: FT energy selection. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.primary: SHELL_FIRST vs QAOA: mean ΔE = E_SHELL_FIRST - E_QAOA, bootstrap 95% CI (4000, rng 3334) entirely <0
gate.secondary: SHELL_FIRST mean E ≤ JOINT mean E (point means; not worse than joint)
gate.otherwise: FAIL / reject. Do not retune. Do not patch GR.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR regardless of gate outcome.
